user.title: Configure Dynamic Energy Cost
user.description: Select your energy (kWh) and price sensors, and choose which accumulation periods to track.

data_description.fixed_addition: A fixed amount added to the price per kWh to account for grid fees, transfer costs, or taxes. Enter this value in the exact same currency as your price sensor (e.g., if your price sensor is in SEK/kWh, input 0.52 for a 52 öre grid fee).

init.title: Adjust Dynamic Energy Cost Settings
init.description: Fixed addition is added to the spot price per kWh. Ntfy notifications send the monthly report's direct download links to your devices after every completed month.

data.notify_enabled: Send ntfy notification after each month

data_description.fixed_addition: Update the fixed amount added to the price per kWh. Enter this value in the exact same currency as your price sensor.
data_description.notify_enabled: On the 1st of each month, the previous month's report is exported and its download links are pushed via ntfy.
data_description.notify_topics: Type a topic name and press Enter for each device. In the ntfy app, subscribe each device to one of these topics. Use long, unguessable topic names — topics act as passwords.
data_description.notify_server: Leave as https://ntfy.sh unless you self-host ntfy.
data_description.notify_time: Time of day on the 1st when the notification is sent (default 09:00).

export_month.name: Export month report
export_month.description: Exports a monthly bookkeeping report (CSV + PDF) to the www/ folder with a downloadable link.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Any date within the month to export, e.g. "2026-06-01" or "2026-06-15". The whole month is exported.
